mapper.sql: P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.TECH_SCOR_SCR AS techScorScr, P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn
CASE WHEN NVL(P.PTCP_SHP_CD, 'PF010') IN ('PF020', 'PF030') THEN (SELECT MAX(C.BIZ_NO) FROM TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C WHERE C.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND C.OUR_CO_YN = 'Y') END
mapper.select: SELECT , AS partnerBizNo FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050' AND P.PBANC_STEP_CD IN ('PP040', 'PP050') AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NOT NULL AND ( OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C WHERE C.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND C.OUR_CO_YN = 'Y')) ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050' AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NOT NULL AND NOT ()
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050' AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NOT NULL AND
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET TECH_SCOR_SCR = NVL(TECH_SCOR_SCR, #{tech, jdbcType=NUMERIC}), PRC_SCOR_SCR = NVL(PRC_SCOR_SCR, #{prc, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}

MERGE INTO TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C USING (SELECT #{pbancSn} AS PBANC_SN, #{bizNo} AS BIZ_NO FROM DUAL) S ON (C.PBANC_SN = S.PBANC_SN AND C.BIZ_NO = S.BIZ_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET C.CO_NM = #{coNm}, C.OPENG_RNK = #{opengRnk, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.BID_AMT = #{bidAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.TECH_EVL_SCR = #{techEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR = #{techEvlOrgnlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.PRC_EVL_SCR = #{prcEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.SNTHS_EVL_SCR = #{snthsEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, C.OUR_CO_YN = #{ourCoYn}, C.SCSBD_YN = #{scsbdYn}, C.CLCT_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PBANC_SN, BIZ_NO, CO_NM, OPENG_RNK, BID_AMT, TECH_EVL_SCR, TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR, PRC_EVL_SCR, SNTHS_EVL_SCR, OUR_CO_YN, SCSBD_YN) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{bizNo}, #{coNm}, #{opengRnk, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{bidAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{techEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{techEvlOrgnlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prcEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{snthsEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ourCoYn}, #{scsbdYn})

MERGE INTO TB_BID_RSLT R USING (SELECT #{pbancSn} AS PBANC_SN FROM DUAL) S ON (R.PBANC_SN = S.PBANC_SN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET R.BID_RSLT_CD = #{bidRsltCd}, R.EVL_RNK = #{evlRnk, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.TECH_EVL_SCR = #{techEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR = #{techEvlOrgnlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.PRC_EVL_SCR = #{prcEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.SNTHS_EVL_SCR = #{snthsEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.SCSBD_AMT = #{scsbdAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, R.CLCT_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PBANC_SN, BID_RSLT_CD, EVL_RNK, TECH_EVL_SCR, TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR, PRC_EVL_SCR, SNTHS_EVL_SCR, SCSBD_AMT, CLCT_DT) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{bidRsltCd}, #{evlRnk, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{techEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{techEvlOrgnlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prcEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{snthsEvlScr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{scsbdAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE)
UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS060', LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050'
mapper.select: SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, S.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, P.OPENG_DT AS opengDt, P.EVL_MTHD_NM AS evlMthdNm, P.TECH_SCOR_SCR AS techScorScr, P.PRC_SCOR_SCR AS prcScorScr, P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn, P.PTCP_SHP_CD AS ptcpShpCd, PF.CD_NM AS ptcpShpNm, AS partnerBizNo FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND S.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PF ON PF.GROUP_CD = 'PTFRM' AND PF.CD = P.PTCP_SHP_CD WHERE P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}

SELECT CO_EVL_RSLT_SN AS coEvlRsltSn, OPENG_RNK AS opengRnk, BIZ_NO AS bizNo, CO_NM AS coNm, BID_AMT AS bidAmt, TECH_EVL_SCR AS techEvlScr, TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR AS techEvlOrgnlScr, PRC_EVL_SCR AS prcEvlScr, SNTHS_EVL_SCR AS snthsEvlScr, OUR_CO_YN AS ourCoYn, SCSBD_YN AS scsbdYn, EVL_TBL_UPLD_YN AS evlTblUpldYn FROM TB_CO_EVL_RSLT WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} ORDER BY OPENG_RNK NULLS LAST, CO_NM

SELECT A.EVL_ARTCL_SN AS evlArtclSn, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM AS evlArtclNm, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR AS evlScorScr, S.CMSNR_NO AS cmsnrNo, S.EVL_SCR AS evlScr FROM TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S JOIN TB_EVL_ARTCL A ON A.EVL_ARTCL_SN = S.EVL_ARTCL_SN WHERE S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn} ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN, S.CMSNR_NO

SELECT S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN AS coEvlRsltSn, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN AS evlArtclSn, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM AS evlArtclNm, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR AS evlScorScr, AVG(S.EVL_SCR) AS avgScr FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL A JOIN TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S ON S.EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN WHERE A.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL K WHERE K.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN) GROUP BY S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR, A.SORT_SEQ ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN

SELECT F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt, E.CMSNR_CNT AS cmsnrCnt FROM TB_EVL_TBL_UPLD E JOIN TB_ATCH_FILE F ON F.FILE_SN = E.FILE_SN LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE E.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn} AND E.LAST_YN = 'Y' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY E.EVL_TBL_UPLD_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_RSLT SET STRPT_CN = #{strptCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SBPT_CS_CN = #{sbptCsCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SPLMNT_CN = #{splmntCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MDFR_ID = #{userId}, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND FILE_SE_CD = 'FL070'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATCH_FILE (PBANC_SN, FILE_SE_CD, VER_NO, LAST_YN, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXTN_NM, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, 'FL070', #{verNo}, 'Y', #{f.orgnlFileNm}, #{f.strgFileNm}, #{f.filePathNm}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExtnNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATCH_FILE SET LAST_YN = 'N' WHERE FILE_SE_CD = 'FL070' AND LAST_YN = 'Y' AND FILE_SN IN (SELECT FILE_SN FROM TB_EVL_TBL_UPLD WHERE CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn} AND LAST_YN = 'Y')
UPDATE TB_EVL_TBL_UPLD SET LAST_YN = 'N' WHERE CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn} AND LAST_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EVL_TBL_UPLD (CO_EVL_RSLT_SN, FILE_SN, LAST_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{coEvlRsltSn}, #{fileSn}, 'Y', #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CO_EVL_RSLT SET EVL_TBL_UPLD_YN = 'Y' WHERE CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn}
mapper.select: SELECT EVL_ARTCL_SN AS evlArtclSn, PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, EVL_ARTCL_NM AS evlArtclNm, EVL_SCOR_SCR AS evlScorScr, SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN IS NULL ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, EVL_ARTCL_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EVL_ARTCL (PBANC_SN, EVL_ARTCL_NM, EVL_SCOR_SCR, SORT_SEQ) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{evlArtclNm}, #{evlScorScr}, #{sortSeq})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EVL_ARTCL SET EVL_SCOR_SCR = #{evlScorScr}, SORT_SEQ = #{sortSeq} WHERE EVL_ARTCL_SN = #{evlArtclSn}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL A WHERE A.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND A.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S WHERE S.EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN)

DELETE FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL A WHERE A.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND A.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S WHERE S.EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL K WHERE K.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR (CO_EVL_RSLT_SN, EVL_ARTCL_SN, CMSNR_NO, EVL_SCR) VALUES (#{coEvlRsltSn}, #{evlArtclSn}, #{cmsnrNo}, #{evlScr})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EVL_TBL_UPLD SET CMSNR_CNT = #{cmsnrCnt} WHERE CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = #{coEvlRsltSn} AND LAST_YN = 'Y'
